description: Put animations on a rigged humanoid, whoever rigged it: a rig_model job, a rigged library character (search_assets with rigged true) or the user's own GLB. Everything goes into one GLB, in place, each animation by name, after any the file has, so calls chain. Two ways: animations, up to 20 of the 79 ids in its schema, from the free library (0 credits; Quaternius' CC0 Universal Animation Library, retargeted onto the rig: walks, jogs, sprints, jumps, rolls, sitting, talking, punches, sword and shield moves, pistols, spells, farm work); or prompt, one motion described in words, made by hunyuan-motion (15 credits, up to 12 s; one person moving, in English, no props or second person). Prefer the library (search_assets with type animation finds its ids by words; each result's animate_id is the id to pass); describe a motion only for what it lacks. Waits about 45 s, then returns job_id for get_job.

animations.description: Library animations to add, by id, free. idle, walk, jog and sprint are what most games need first.

mesh.description: The rigged model: job_... (from rig_model), a library id, an upload id or a URL.

prompt.description: A motion in words, instead of animations: "waves hello, then sits down cross-legged". Costs credits.

seconds.description: With prompt: how long the motion lasts.

name: animate_model
title: Animate a rigged character
